mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.purpose, r.status, mr.room_id AS mr_roomId, mr.image AS mr_image, mr.name AS mr_name, mr.building AS mr_building, mr.floor AS mr_floor, mr.capacity_min AS mr_capacityMin, mr.capacity_max AS mr_capacityMax, mr.status AS mr_status, mr.facilities AS mr_facilities, ua.user_id AS attendee_userId, ua.username AS attendee_username, ua.avatar AS attendee_avatar, ua.email AS attendee_email, ua.status AS attendee_status, ua.created_at AS attendee_createdAt, ua.updated_at AS attendee_updatedAt FROM ( SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid UNION SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE attendees @> jsonb_build_array(#{userId}::text) ) AS r JOIN meeting_rooms mr ON r.room_id = mr.room_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.attendees) AS attendee_id ) AS a ON true LEFT JOIN users ua ON ua.user_id::text = a.attendee_id

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.purpose, r.status, mr.room_id AS mr_roomId, mr.image AS mr_image, mr.name AS mr_name, mr.building AS mr_building, mr.floor AS mr_floor, mr.capacity_min AS mr_capacityMin, mr.capacity_max AS mr_capacityMax, mr.status AS mr_status, mr.facilities AS mr_facilities, ua.user_id AS attendee_userId, ua.username AS attendee_username, ua.avatar AS attendee_avatar, ua.email AS attendee_email, ua.status AS attendee_status, ua.created_at AS attendee_createdAt, ua.updated_at AS attendee_updatedAt FROM reservations r JOIN meeting_rooms mr ON r.room_id = mr.room_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.attendees) AS attendee_id ) AS a ON true LEFT JOIN users ua ON ua.user_id::text = a.attendee_id

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, u.username AS userName, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.purpose, r.status, mr.room_id AS mr_roomId, mr.image AS mr_image, mr.name AS mr_name, mr.building AS mr_building, mr.floor AS mr_floor, mr.capacity_min AS mr_capacityMin, mr.capacity_max AS mr_capacityMax, mr.status AS mr_status, mr.facilities AS mr_facilities, ua.user_id AS attendee_userId, ua.username AS attendee_username, ua.avatar AS attendee_avatar, ua.email AS attendee_email, ua.status AS attendee_status, ua.created_at AS attendee_createdAt, ua.updated_at AS attendee_updatedAt FROM reservations r JOIN meeting_rooms mr ON r.room_id = mr.room_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.attendees) AS attendee_id ) AS a ON true LEFT JOIN users ua ON ua.user_id::text = a.attendee_id WHERE start_time >= #{targetTime} - INTERVAL '500 milliseconds' AND start_time <= #{targetTime} + INTERVAL '500 milliseconds'
